what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Laos, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters fell from 265 in 2016 to 5 in 2021.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Laos list floods and storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Laos in these years.

when.text: The count then rose to 1274 in 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2019 and 2023 to 2024.

how.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 3429 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Laos.
